_comment: Style advisor knowledge base. Edit without touching Python.

brand_size_notes.nike: Nike runs true to size. Wide feet should go half a size up.
brand_size_notes.adidas: Adidas runs slightly narrow. Wide feet should size up half a size.
brand_size_notes.new balance: New Balance offers wide widths (2E, 4E). True to size in standard.
brand_size_notes.asics: Asics runs true to size. Good arch support for overpronation.
brand_size_notes.brooks: Brooks runs true to size. Excellent for wide feet.
brand_size_notes.hoka: Hoka runs true to size with a roomy toe box.
brand_size_notes.converse: Converse runs large — size down half a size.
brand_size_notes.vans: Vans run true to size for standard width.
brand_size_notes.puma: Puma runs slightly small — size up half if between sizes.
brand_size_notes.salomon: Salomon trail shoes run true. Snug fit by design.
brand_size_notes.timberland: Timberland boots run half a size large.

foot_type_advice.wide: Look for New Balance (2E/4E widths), Brooks, or ASICS. Size up half in narrow brands like Adidas.
foot_type_advice.narrow: Adidas, Saucony, and Mizuno tend to run narrower.
foot_type_advice.flat: Look for motion control shoes — Brooks Adrenaline, New Balance 860, ASICS Gel-Kayano.
foot_type_advice.high arch: Cushioned neutral shoes work best — HOKA, Brooks Ghost, New Balance Fresh Foam.
foot_type_advice.overpronation: Stability shoes are ideal — ASICS GT series, Brooks Adrenaline, New Balance 860.
